[RLOW.7.3.1] The call's `ACTION_CALL` enters the dispatcher ([IDSP.6]) as
`(service, correlation, args)`: the service from the dotted path; the
correlation from `as`, or, for a call with no `as`, the one the compiler
generates for each firing ([LCRS.3.1], [LCCO.3.4]); and one typed argument per kwarg the call supplies other than the call-site modifiers
`cooldown` and `as` ([LCRS.14.13]). The compiler emits each such
kwarg as its name and its value expression, sorted by name and laid out as
[RDSC.4a.9.4] states, so the artefact is the same whatever the source order. The runtime evaluates each value to its
kind ([RFCS.23.2]); a fact kwarg's binding becomes a `FactExternal`
([RFCS.23.1]). No JSON is built. A `Float` argument whose value is NaN refuses
the call ([LEXP.4.2]).
